description.narrative: A secondment Associate Director Economic Governance within the department for Competitiveness, Governance and Political Affairs (CGPA) which is part of Policy Strategy and Delivery (PSD) Department. CGPA works to maintain sound economic governance in its partner countries by supporting structural reforms that deal with the obstacles that exist to growth and thereby increase competitiveness and enable investment.A second ring which Associate Director Economic Governance within the department for Competitiveness, Governance and Political Affairs (CGPA) which is part of Policy Strategy and Delivery (PSD) Department under Vice Presidency of Policy and Partnerships (VP3). CGPA works to maintain sound economic governance in its partner countries by supporting structural reforms that deal with the obstacles that exist to growth and thereby increase competitiveness and enable investment.

En sekundering som Associate Director Economic Governance inom avdelningen för Competitiveness, Governance and Political Affairs (CGPA) som är en del av Policy Strategy and Delivery (PSD) Department. CGPA arbetar med att upprätthålla en sund ekonomisk styrning i sina partnerländers genom att stödja strukturella reformer som hanterar de hinder som finns för tillväxt och därmed ökar konkurrenskraften och möjliggör investeringar.
